description: One connector of a DiagramBriefPage. Both the endpoint node ids and their stencil ids are carried, so an agent can reason about what is connected without resolving the nodes itself. Endpoints are nullable because a connector may be dangling.

members.name: SourceNodeId
members.description: Id of the source node, or null when the endpoint is unattached.

members.name: SourceStencilId
members.description: Stencil id of the source node, when attached.

members.name: TargetNodeId
members.description: Id of the target node, or null when the endpoint is unattached.

members.name: TargetStencilId
members.description: Stencil id of the target node, when attached.

members.name: Label
members.description: The connector's label, when it has one.
